title: Towards a Formal Definition of Agent Memory: Basis, Span, Optimality, and the Sequential Memory Problem
abstract: arXiv:2608.11654v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Despite the wide deployment of memory in large-model agents, there is no unified formal account of what a memory is or when it is optimal. This paper takes a first step toward this account. The central idea is that memory is a basis, knowledge is its span, and answerability is a coverage problem: an agent stores events extracted from a material; a generation operator turns any event set into the knowledge it entails; and a query is answerable exactly when some single item in the span covers it. The optimal memory is then the capacity-constrained maximizer of expected coverage, and its value traces a utility--capacity frontier, the common yardstick on which memory systems can be compared. Next, we consider noise in the memory and discuss coverage versus precision under it: a memory may store false claims, so the write policy must infer the truth of what it stores. translated_title: 走向智能体记忆的形式化定义：基础、跨度、最优性及序列记忆问题
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11654v1 公告类型：新 摘要：尽管记忆在大模型智能体中广泛部署，但对于什么是记忆或何时是最优的，尚无统一的形式化解释。本文朝这一解释迈出了第一步。核心思想是：记忆是基础，知识是其跨度，可回答性是一个覆盖问题——智能体存储从材料中提取的事件；生成算子将任何事件集转化为其蕴含的知识；当且仅当跨度中的某个单一项目覆盖查询时，查询才可回答。最优记忆则是容量约束下期望覆盖的最大化者，其价值描绘了一条效用-容量边界，这是比较记忆系统的通用标准。接下来，我们考虑记忆中的噪声，并讨论其下的覆盖与精度：记忆可能存储虚假声明，因此写入策略必须推断其存储内容的真实性。借鉴生物记忆的类比，生物记忆是连续形成的，我们引入序列记忆问题，其中记忆随时间更新，并分析其复杂性及近似保证。
tldr: 本文首次提出智能体记忆的形式化定义，将记忆视为基础、知识视为跨度、最优性视为容量约束下的覆盖最大化，并引入序列记忆问题以处理噪声和随时间更新的挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a first formal definition of agent memory, treating memory as a basis, knowledge as its span, optimality as capacity-constrained coverage maximization, and introducing the sequential memory problem to address noise and temporal updates.
